hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; FILE_DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); FILE_REPO=$(git -C "$FILE_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -z "$FILE_REPO" ]; then exit 0; fi; BRANCH=$(git -C "$FILE_REPO" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "BLOCKED: You are on main/master. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feature/your-task"}' >&2; exit 2; fi
